title: knautia integrifolia var. typica
intro: Knautia integrifolia var. typica, commonly known as Edible Knotgrass or Wild Knotweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the Caprifoliaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Knautia integrifolia var. typica include antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which help in relieving coughs and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
